description: The plot illustrates "Performance w.r.t. Temperature," representing the Accuracy (Pass@8) of three different methods across varying temperature levels. The x-axis is labeled "Temperature" and utilizes a linear scale ranging from 0.1 to 1.0, with numeric tick marks spaced at intervals of 0.1 and no specified units. The y-axis, labeled "Accuracy (Pass@8)", also follows a linear scale, with tick marks ranging from 62.5 to 80.0 at intervals of 2.5. The solid orange line with upward-pointing triangle markers, labeled "On-policy RL," begins at an initial value of approximately 63.7 at x=0.1, rises to roughly 69.8 at x=0.2, and experiences fluctuations including a steady period at 71.6 between x=0.5 and x=0.6, a decline to 67.1 at x=0.7, a peak of roughly 75.2 at x=0.8, and ends at 73.4 at x=1.0. The solid dark red line with star markers represents "LUFFY"; it starts at approximately 76.1 at x=0.1, rises to 78.8 at x=0.2, and drops to a steady 76.1 between x=0.3 and x=0.4. It then shows an overall upward trend, with steady values of 77.0 between x=0.5 and x=0.6, reaching peak values of approximately 80.6 at both x=0.8 and x=1.0, separated by a dip to 78.8 at x=0.9. The solid dark teal line with downward-pointing triangle markers, representing "SFT," begins at approximately 76.1 at x=0.1, declines to a steady 74.3 between x=0.3 and x=0.4, and drops to a low of 69.8 at x=0.5. It then rises to a peak of 76.1 at x=0.6 before fluctuating through the rest of the range, ultimately ending at approximately 74.3 at x=1.0.
